privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.description: Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information at MyStore.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, make a purchase, contact us, or subscribe to our newsletter. This may include your name, email address, shipping address, phone number, and payment information.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use the information we collect to process orders, send order confirmations, respond to inquiries, send promotional communications (with your consent), and improve our services.

sections.heading: Information Sharing
sections.content: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our website, conducting our business, or serving you, such as payment processors and shipping carriers.

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. All payment transactions are encrypted using industry-standard SSL technology.

sections.heading: Cookies & Tracking
sections.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and personalize content. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. You may also request a copy of your data or opt out of marketing communications at any time by contacting us.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.content: For privacy-related inquiries, please contact us at support@mystore.com.

terms-of-service.title: Terms of Service
terms-of-service.description: Read our terms of service governing your use of MyStore website and services.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing and using MyStore ("the Website"), you accept and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our Website or services.

sections.heading: 2. Use of Our Services
sections.content: You agree to use our services only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these Terms. You must not use the Website in any way that violates applicable laws, attempt unauthorized access, use automated systems without permission, or transmit malicious code.

sections.heading: 3. Account Registration
sections.content: To make purchases, you may be required to create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account.

sections.heading: 4. Products & Pricing
sections.content: We strive to display product information and pricing accurately. However, we do not warrant that descriptions, images, or prices are error-free. We reserve the right to correct errors and update pricing at any time.

sections.heading: 5. Orders & Payment
sections.content: All orders are subject to acceptance and availability. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel any order. Payment is processed securely through our payment provider.

sections.heading: 6. Intellectual Property
sections.content: All content on the Website is the property of MyStore or its licensors and is protected by intellectual property laws. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works without our prior written consent.

sections.heading: 7. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: To the fullest extent permitted by law, MyStore shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of the Website. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount you paid for the product.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to These Terms
sections.content: We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. Changes will be posted with an updated date. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance.

sections.heading: 9. Contact Us
sections.content: For questions about these Terms, contact us at support@mystore.com.

refund-policy.title: Refund Policy
refund-policy.description: Our refund and return policy including 30-day return window, refund process, and conditions.

sections.heading: 30-Day Return Policy
sections.content: We offer a 30-day return window from the date of delivery. If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, you may return it within 30 days for a full refund, subject to the conditions below.

sections.heading: Eligibility for Returns
sections.content: To be eligible, items must be unused, in original packaging, with proof of purchase. Certain items cannot be returned: perishable goods, custom-made products, and personal care items.

sections.heading: How to Initiate a Return
sections.content: Contact us at support@mystore.com with your order number and reason. We will provide an RMA number and shipping instructions. Ship using a trackable method — you are responsible for return shipping unless the return is due to our error.

sections.heading: Refund Processing
sections.content: Approved refunds are processed within 5–10 business days of receiving the returned item. Allow an additional 3–5 business days for the refund to appear on your statement.

sections.heading: Damaged or Defective Items
sections.content: If you receive a damaged or defective item, contact us within 7 days of delivery with photos. We will arrange a replacement or full refund at no cost to you.

sections.heading: Non-Refundable Items
sections.content: Gift cards, downloadable software or digital products, and items marked as "Final Sale" or "Non-returnable" cannot be refunded.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.content: For refund questions, contact us at support@mystore.com.

shipping-policy.title: Shipping Policy
shipping-policy.description: Learn about our shipping methods, delivery times, and rates for worldwide delivery.

sections.heading: Order Processing Time
sections.content: All orders are processed within 1–2 business days. Orders placed on weekends or holidays will be processed on the next business day.

sections.heading: Shipping Methods & Delivery Times
sections.content: Standard Shipping: 7–14 business days (Free). Express Shipping: 3–5 business days ($9.99). Priority Shipping: 1–3 business days ($19.99).

sections.heading: Shipping Destinations
sections.content: We ship to most countries worldwide. Availability and delivery times may vary by location. Remote areas may have limited options.

sections.heading: Order Tracking
sections.content: Once your order ships, you will receive a confirmation email with a tracking number to monitor your package.

sections.heading: Customs & Import Duties
sections.content: International orders may be subject to customs duties and taxes. These charges are the responsibility of the recipient.

sections.heading: Lost or Damaged Packages
sections.content: If your package arrives damaged or does not arrive, contact us at support@mystore.com within 30 days and we will resolve the issue.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.content: For shipping questions, contact us at support@mystore.com.
